title: HVAC Marketing Statistics (2026): Lead Costs, Reviews & Speed to Lead
meta: The HVAC marketing numbers that matter: cost per booked job by channel, how many Google reviews it takes to rank in HVAC, speed-to-lead data — all sourced.
short: The HVAC-specific numbers behind getting booked: what a booked job really costs by channel, the ~519 reviews it takes to top a competitive HVAC market, and why answering in 5 minutes changes everything.
statLabel: Reviews to rank #1 in a competitive HVAC map pack — 15x a low-competition trade

body.answer: Measure per booked job, not per lead.
body.html: For HVAC, a booked job runs roughly $542 via Angi, ~$250 via Thumbtack, and ~$168 via Google Local Service Ads once close rates are counted. Shared leads are sold to as many as 12 pros, which is why their cheap sticker price produces the most expensive jobs.

body.h2: HVAC reviews: the highest bar in the trades
body.answer: Competitive HVAC markets take ~519 reviews to top.
body.html: HVAC is one of the most review-hungry trades: ranking #1 in a competitive metro can take on the order of ~519 reviews (BrightLocal 2026), versus a fraction of that in low-competition markets. And 91% of homeowners won't consider a shop under 4 stars — so rating gates the call before it happens.

body.h2: Speed to lead wins HVAC jobs
body.html: 78% of homeowners hire whoever responds first (Lead Connect 2026), and responding in 5 minutes vs 30 makes you up to 100x more likely to connect (MIT Sloan 2026). For emergency-driven HVAC calls, speed is the whole game.

faq.q: How much does an HVAC lead cost in 2026?
faq.a: Per booked job: roughly $542 via Angi, ~$250 via Thumbtack, ~$168 via Google Local Service Ads once close rates are counted. Per-lead prices hide the close rate.

faq.q: How many Google reviews does an HVAC company need?
faq.a: Enough to clear 4 stars and be competitive locally — ranking #1 in a tough HVAC market can take ~519 reviews (BrightLocal 2026); low-competition areas need far fewer.

faq.q: What's the fastest way to get more HVAC jobs?
faq.a: Answer leads in minutes. 78% of homeowners hire whoever responds first (Lead Connect 2026), and 5-minute response is up to 100x more likely to connect than 30 (MIT Sloan 2026).
